entries.test: Microsoft's FY26 disclosures and supporting revenue analyses would establish OpenAI's share of its AI revenue and total revenue.
entries.note: The executive summary asserts the 70% threshold firmly, despite the quoted Bloomberg analysis being qualified.

entries.test: Microsoft's financial disclosures would establish cumulative capital expenditures from the beginning of 2022 through the reporting period available at publication.
entries.note: The later $270 billion figure differs from this assertion; that does not make either uncheckable.

entries.test: Microsoft's FY2026 disclosure of revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI would settle the $24.1 billion figure.
entries.note: This is Zitron's own summary assertion, separately supported by a quoted disclosure.

entries.test: Published analyst estimates would establish whether they attribute over 70% of combined AI revenues across Microsoft, Google and Amazon to OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.note: The proposition retains attribution to analyst estimates; it does not assert an audited revenue share.

entries.test: Microsoft's disclosed FY26 OpenAI revenue divided by its disclosed total revenue would establish whether the share was approximately 7.26% of $331.8 billion.
Microsoft's capital expenditure disclosures and public evidence of infrastructure allocation and use would establish whether $270 billion in spending supported OpenAI alone.
entries.note: The normalization adds 'about' and 'essentially,' softening the original assertion. The plain reading concerns spending and its beneficiary, rather than an inaccessible private motive.

entries.test: Microsoft's reported AI revenue growth, contracts and commercial products would establish whether its AI efforts generated material additional revenue or business opportunities by publication.
entries.note: The assertion concerns the commercial results caused by Microsoft's AI efforts. 'Significant' allows a plain reading of material business growth.

'Little to show' supplies no shared standard for weighing revenue, infrastructure, products and other benefits against spending. The separate characterization of OpenAI is extracted in the next claim.

entries.test: Public financial reporting on OpenAI's operating cash flows, compute obligations and external funding dependence would establish whether it could sustain its cloud payments from its business revenues.
entries.note: 'Near-infinite' is hyperbole, but the sentence has a testable financial core: dependence on enormous continuing external support to meet compute bills.
